selection_protocol: Three complete recordings from three publishers, none used before by ClipMind. Explicit reusable licenses. English Go code with a speaker inset (FOSDEM), Mandarin slides with Python/config code and a live demo (PyCon Taiwan), and a Mandarin room-camera recording of a projected screen (COSCUP). Selected from source thumbnails only.
